themes.name: Agentic AI in research

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, acting as assistants in the software development process.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing specific AI-powered platforms, software, and frameworks designed to facilitate and accelerate various research activities.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is affecting jobs, roles, skills, and the overall labor market, including concerns about displacement and augmentation.

themes.name: AI summarization

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare and evaluate different AI tools for research purposes, highlighting their features, performance, and suitability for specific tasks.

themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into the design process, from conceptualization to prototyping and user experience enhancement.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles discussing the creation and use of artificial or simulated user data and personas for research and testing purposes.

themes.description: Content focusing on AI's capability to analyze user feedback, reviews, and sentiment to extract opinions, emotions, and actionable insights.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
